properties.description: Built 2026-10-23, PR A2. `claimed_by` (Requirement, Constraint, Inference; add_requirement, add_constraint, add_inference) names the party. A claim that does not hold, is not contested or refuted, and carries or rests on a claim reads proof_status/statement_reading `claimed`, reasoning_report `claimed_by` and a `why` starting "claimed by OpenAI, unverified"; propagate_from rows read `conclusion_was: claimed` and `conclusion_reads: open` once the claimant's argument is dropped (`claimed_by` lists who still claims it). TemporalFacts with fact_type status (HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT) are read back as `status_over_time` on reasoning_report claims and a step's get_node; a claim or step that does not hold now with every status ended reads `withdrawn` (period, record, the objections that withdrew it). Measured: NS (C) unproven→claimed; Kempe's 1879 step withdrawn 1879–1890 by Heawood's objection; Tait 1880–1891.
properties.name: A claim a named party made reads "claimed by <party>, unverified", a what-if dropping the claimant's argument reads it open, and a status held over a period is read back, a claim whose period ended reading withdrawn
